summary: VB6 legacy conventions with COM dependencies, event-driven architecture, and data binding patterns. Modernization framework follows Python/FastAPI patterns with agent-based architecture.

rules.rule: Forms prefixed with 'frm' followed by descriptive name (e.g., frmLogin, frmdeposit)
Controls prefixed with type abbreviation (txt for TextBox, cmd for CommandButton)
Agent modules imported using relative imports in __init__.py
Data access through ADO 2.5 and Data Environment designers

lint_recommendations: Implement consistent error handling patterns across VB6 forms
Standardize data validation in form controls
Add input sanitization for SQL injection prevention
Implement consistent logging across all transactions
Add unit tests for Python modernization agents
scaffold_templates: VB6 Form to React Component mapping template
ADO Recordset to REST API endpoint template
VB6 Event Handler to JavaScript event listener template
Data Environment to ORM model template
